historicalDiscrepancyResolution: The 12 November evidence captured earlier Agent Card bytes that did not match the then-observed Registry metadata. The 20 November Registry now points at a pinned GitHub commit whose buyer card matches the current checkout, while its seller card matches an older seller snapshot. This explains why a Registry check can report cardMatches=true while the current seller file differs: the Registry verifies the card at its on-chain Agent URI, not automatically the current main-branch file.
